newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks retreat, leading issues resist.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks retreat, leading issues resist.

text.p: Croatian stocks retreated on Thursday on light profit taking and only the leading issues resisted the downward trend.
* Six of 10 active stocks fell, three rose and one was flat.
* Volume higher at 11,210 units, turnover 6.2 million kuna.
* Biggest decliner was electric concern Koncar, down 40 kuna or 9.75 percent to 370 with 50 shares changing hands.
* Top gainer, Zagrebacka Banka, rose 15 kuna to 995 on volume of 2,770.
* Most actively traded, food processor Podravka with 4,449 shares sold, eased four kuna to close at 226. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
